statements.status_notes: CVE-2017-0641 targets Android Mediaserver with a lowered libvpx --size-limit for smartphones. Debian security tracker classifies this as NOT-FOR-US for Android Mediaserver; Debian libvpx builds configure with --size-limit=16384x16384 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2017-0641).
